description.value: Umai Sushi & Grill is a Japanese and Asian fusion restaurant in Garibaldi Highlands, Squamish, offering an extensive menu of creative sushi rolls, aburi, teriyaki, and chirashi bowls. The restaurant positions itself as a comfortable dine-in space suitable for casual lunches through larger group dinners, and also offers online ordering for takeout. It sits in the Tantalus Road commercial area of Garibaldi Highlands, a node frequently passed by cyclists riding the Sea-to-Sky corridor.
